lines.en: I tap on Ami’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Ami 的名字,等她接听。

lines.en: I’m feeling a bit out of it today, so it would probably be nice to just lounge around the house with her.
lines.zh: 我今天有点提不起劲,所以跟她一起窝在家里,大概会挺舒服。

lines.en: Plus, something like this is definitely easier and significantly less risky than inviting anyone else over.
lines.zh: 况且,这种事肯定比邀请别人过来简单得多、风险小得多。

lines.en: Slightly strange, considering that she lives with me and inviting her to her own house is conceptually weird-
lines.zh: 虽然仔细想想有点怪——她就住在我家,邀请她来「自己家」在概念上就很拧巴——

lines.en: But yeah, definitely easier.
lines.zh: 但没错,肯定简单多了。

lines.en: : Hello? [amimaster]? What’s up?
lines.zh: : 喂?[amimaster]?怎么啦?

lines.en: : Did you need something?
lines.zh: : 找我有事吗?

lines.en: : Hey, Ami. Are you doing anything today?
lines.zh: : 嗨,Ami。你今天有安排吗?

lines.en: : Hm? I’m just making dinner right now. Are you coming home early?
lines.zh: : 嗯?我在做晚饭呢。你要提前回家?

lines.en: : Want me to save you some?
lines.zh: : 要我给你留一份吗?

lines.en: : Actually, I was wondering if you’d want to come over today.
lines.zh: : 其实,我在想你要不要今天「过来」一趟。

lines.en: : Come over where?
lines.zh: : 过来哪?

lines.en: : Come over our house.
lines.zh: : 来我们家。

lines.en: : You’re...inviting me to...our house?
lines.zh: : 你在……邀请我……去我们家?

lines.en: : But I...just told you I'm here.
lines.zh: : 可我……刚刚才告诉你我就在这儿。

lines.en: : Are you okay? Did you hit your head somewhere?!
lines.zh: : 你没事吧?你是不是撞到头了?!

lines.en: : Hold on, [amimaster]! I’ll call an ambulance!
lines.zh: : 等一下,[amimaster]!我这就叫救护车!

lines.en: : No ambulance needed.
lines.zh: : 不用叫救护车。

lines.en: : I just wanted to make sure you were okay with visiting your own house.
lines.zh: : 我只是想确认一下,你回「自己家」之前,是否感觉良好。

lines.en: : The ambulance is on the way, [amimaster]! Just hold on!
lines.zh: : 救护车已经在路上了,[amimaster]!你撑住!

lines.en: I manage to convince Ami to call off the ambulance as I walk home.
lines.zh: 在我走回家的路上,我总算说服 Ami 取消了救护车。

lines.en: Thankfully, we don’t live in the US and thus incur no additional fees after she has one dispatched.
lines.zh: 幸好我们不住在美国,她叫完那一趟,也不用额外产生任何费用。

lines.en: I end the phone call as I make my way to the door, sliding my cell back into my pocket as I turn the handle.
lines.zh: 走到门口时我挂断电话,转动门把的同时把手机塞回口袋。

lines.en: Ami greets me with a hug and sets out a plate for me on the table that I promptly devour.
lines.zh: Ami 用一个拥抱迎接我,在桌上为我摆好餐盘,我一扫而光。

lines.en: Once she finishes hers (Which takes exponentially longer- that girl eats very slowly), we make our way into my room for once.
lines.zh: 等她吃完她自己那份(耗时呈指数级增长——那女孩吃东西超级慢),我们难得地一起进了我的房间。

lines.en: Typically, if the two of us were going to hang out, it would be in either the living room or, in some rare cases, her room.
lines.zh: 通常来说,我们要是想待在一起,要么在客厅,偶尔去她房间。

lines.en: So having her in here is actually kind of odd now that I think about it.
lines.zh: 所以认真一想,让她待在我这里,其实还挺新鲜的。

lines.en: : Wow...I can’t even remember the last time I was in here.
lines.zh: : 哇……我都想不起上一次进这里是什么时候了。

lines.en: : Probably the last time you had to come wake me up or clean my room.
lines.zh: : 大概是上一次你不得不进来叫醒我,或者帮我打扫房间的时候。

lines.en: : Besides those times, obviously.
lines.zh: : 那些时候显然不算。

lines.en: : I mean just...hanging out in here.
lines.zh: : 我是说就……在这里面待着。

lines.en: : You’ve been getting better at waking up when I call out to you anyway. There’s barely a reason for me to actually come in anymore.
lines.zh: : 反正你最近被我叫的时候,起床越来越利索了。我都基本没理由真进来了。

lines.en: : So...why are we in here today?
lines.zh: : 那……今天我们为什么在这?

lines.en: : Sexy stuff?
lines.zh: : 不可描述的事?

lines.en: : Surprisingly, no.
lines.zh: : 出乎意料地,不是。

lines.en: : I’ve been feeling really tired all day, so I kind of wanted to just relax and hang out with my one and only [niece].
lines.zh: : 我今天一整天都觉得特别累,所以就想放松一下,跟我独一无二的 [niece] 待着。

lines.en: : Why are you specifying that I’m your one and only [niece]? Wording it like that makes me think you’re hiding something.
lines.zh: : 你为什么要特意强调「独一无二」?这种措辞让我觉得你在藏东西。

lines.en: : [amimaster], if you’re hiding any extra [niece]s from me, I will destroy them. I want you to know that.
lines.zh: : [amimaster],你要是敢藏任何多余 [niece] 不让我知道,我会把她们全部毁灭。我要你记住这一点。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s...not a thing you need to worry about.
lines.zh: : 对,这个……你完全不用担心。

lines.en: : Hooray! Now I know your [incest] fetish is specific to me and me only!
lines.zh: : 万岁!这下我知道你的 [incest] 癖好只针对我一个人了!

lines.en: : Hooray! Now I don’t have to worry about anyone taking you from me!
lines.zh: : 万岁!这下我不用再担心有人把你从我身边抢走了!

lines.en: : Calm down, Ami.
lines.zh: : 冷静点,Ami。

lines.en: : What you and I have together is special.
lines.zh: : 你我之间拥有的东西是特别的。

lines.en: : There's no one who could ever take your place.
lines.zh: : 没有任何人能取代你的位置。

lines.en: : Okay, something’s going on, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 好的,一定有事发生了,对吧?

lines.en: : First, you come home on time. Then you take me into your room...and now you’re saying adorable stuff to me.
lines.zh: : 首先,你今天准点回家。然后你把我带进你的房间……现在还在对我说可爱的话。

lines.en: : Is everything okay, [amimaster]? I don’t know if the ambulance made it back to the hospital yet, but-
lines.zh: : 你还好吗,[amimaster]?我不知道救护车回到医院了没有,但是——

lines.en: : Again, I’m okay. Stop threatening to call ambulances each time I act out of character.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍,我没事。每当我表现反常,别动不动就威胁叫救护车。

lines.en: : Sorry. I’ve just gotten so used to you neglecting me lately that the sudden increase in attention is making me nervous.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。只是最近你冷落我冷落得太习惯了,注意力突然回升反而让我紧张。

lines.en: : Like you’re about to break some bad news to me or something.
lines.zh: : 总感觉你正准备宣布什么坏消息什么的。

lines.en: : Actually, now that you mention it, I do have some bad news.
lines.zh: : 其实,既然你提到了,我确实有个坏消息。

lines.en: : Ah! Here it comes! I thought I was ready but I’m really not!
lines.zh: : 啊!来了来了!我以为我准备好了,其实根本没有!

lines.en: : You, see Ami...I-
lines.zh: : 你听我说,Ami……我——

lines.en: : You do have hidden family members you never told me about, don’t you?!
lines.zh: : 你确实有一群从来没告诉我过的隐藏亲戚,对不对?!

lines.en: : How many of them have twintails?!
lines.zh: : 他们里有几个是双马尾?!

lines.en: : Tell me or I’ll kill myself!
lines.zh: : 快说,不然我就自杀!

lines.en: : I was just going to say my legs are tired from walking all the way home and that I want to sit down.
lines.zh: : 我只是想说,走了一路回家腿很酸,想坐下而已。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Your definition of “bad news” is a lot different from mine.
lines.zh: : 你对「坏消息」的定义和我的差别真大。

lines.en: : I can see that.
lines.zh: : 我看得出来。

lines.en: : How’s that even bad, [amimaster]?
lines.zh: : 这怎么能算坏消息嘛,[amimaster]?

lines.en: : You had just gotten so into voicing your concern for me that I felt a little bad about having to interrupt you.
lines.zh: : 你刚才沉迷于表达对我的关心,打断你我还有点过意不去。

lines.en: : But if you’d like to keep talking about how awesome I am, feel free. I’m just going to sit down for it.
lines.zh: : 但你要是想继续夸我有多好,请便。我就坐下听。

lines.en: : Then I’ll sit down with you! I’m not just gonna stand here and keep shouting across the room. That would be weird.
lines.zh: : 那我跟你一起坐!我总不能一直站在这边,隔着整个房间喊话吧。那太怪了。

lines.en: : In fact, I’m gonna get all up in your space and rub up against you to mark my territory.
lines.zh: : 不仅如此,我还要挤进你的私人空间,在你身上蹭来蹭去,宣示主权。

lines.en: : Are you an animal now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是一只动物了吗?

lines.en: : Do you have a purrrrrroblem with that, [amimaster]?~
lines.zh: : 你对此有什么意——见吗,[amimaster]?~

lines.en: : Not as long as I can feed you out of a bowl and keep you up to date on your shots.
lines.zh: : 只要能用碗喂你、按时带你打疫苗,倒也没有。

lines.en: : Heheh, I knew you’d li-
lines.zh: : 呵呵,我就知道你会喜——

lines.en: : Wait, why is that the first thing your mind went to? Don’t you wanna pet me or scratch my chin or something?
lines.zh: : 等等,你的脑子为什么第一个想到的是这个?你不想摸摸我、挠挠我下巴什么的吗?

lines.en: : Once I confirm you’re properly vaccinated, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然,前提是先确认你疫苗打全了。

lines.en: : Just go sit down, already. Clearly the cat thing isn’t something you’re interested in right now.
lines.zh: : 你还是赶紧坐下吧。很明显,你现在对猫这套没兴趣。

lines.en: Ami follows me as I make my way to the bed, waiting for me to sit down before-
lines.zh: Ami 跟着我走向床边,等我坐下之后——

lines.en: : Move your legs a little.
lines.zh: : 腿挪一挪。

lines.en: : What, why?
lines.zh: : 什么?为什么?

lines.en: : I said move ‘em, mister!
lines.zh: : 说了挪就挪,先生!

lines.en: : Here, I’ll do it for you-
lines.zh: : 来,我帮你挪——

lines.en: : Welp, this is better than nothing, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好吧,有总比没有强,我猜。

lines.en: : So, where were we?
lines.zh: : 那么,我们刚才聊到哪了?

lines.en: : You were talking about how much you love me, right?
lines.zh: : 你在说你有多爱我,对吧?

lines.en: : That is not a thing I have said even once today.
lines.zh: : 我今天一次都没说过这句话。

lines.en: : Are you sure? I distinctly heard an “I love you, Ami” as soon as you came home tonight.
lines.zh: : 你确定?今晚你一进门,我清晰地听到了一句「我爱你,Ami」。

lines.en: : Probably just the voices inside of your head or something.
lines.zh: : 大概是你脑子里的声音之类的吧。

lines.en: : I don’t think so. Those are a lot less reserved.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得。脑子里的那些声音,可比这放肆多了。

lines.en: : Wait, you don’t actually have-
lines.zh: : 等等,你难道真的有——

lines.en: : Hey, [amimaster]...do you remember how this room used to look before I moved in?
lines.zh: : 嘿,[amimaster]……你还记得这个房间在我搬进来之前长什么样吗?

lines.en: I can’t even remember my name, let alone something that happened before I “existed” here.
lines.zh: 我连自己的名字都想不起来,更别提我「存在」于此之前的事了。

lines.en: : I can’t say I do.
lines.zh: : 恕我记不得。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的吗?

lines.en: : I guess that makes sense, though.
lines.zh: : 不过倒也说得通。

lines.en: : You were a lot different back then. A lot more...spacious?
lines.zh: : 那时候的你跟现在很不一样。要……空旷得多?

lines.en: : Are you calling me fat?
lines.zh: : 你是在说我胖?

lines.en: : No, no. What’s the word for when somebody like, wanders around and doesn’t really have any idea what they’re doing and stuff?
lines.zh: : 不不。就是那种,一个人到处晃悠、完全不知道自己在干什么之类的状态,那个词叫什么来着?

lines.en: : Oh. I think you’re thinking of “spaced out.”
lines.zh: : 哦。你说的应该是「神游天外」。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah! That!
lines.zh: : 对对对!就那个!

lines.en: : You were always super spaced out. To the point where you’d have food from like, weeks ago still out on your desk and bottles all over the floor and stuff.
lines.zh: : 你以前整天神游天外。桌上的食物能放几个星期,地板上到处都是瓶子什么的。

lines.en: : But you weren’t exactly in the best state of mind back then. And, to be fair, neither was I.
lines.zh: : 不过那时候你的精神状态确实不好。公平地说,我也一样。

lines.en: : We were both really lazy for way longer than we ever should have been.
lines.zh: : 我们俩的颓废期,都远超必要的长度。

lines.en: : I guess it’s kind of good that we wound up breaking each other out of it, huh?
lines.zh: : 所以说,我们最后把彼此从那里面拽了出来,也算是一件好事,对吧?

lines.en: : Imagine how things would be if the house was still like that?
lines.zh: : 想象一下,要是这房子还是老样子,会变成什么样?

lines.en: : Filled with rotting food and discarded tissues from all of our tears...
lines.zh: : 堆满腐烂的食物,和挤满我们眼泪的纸巾……

lines.en: : Well, my tissues were from tears. Yours were probably from a few things.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我的纸巾是眼泪。你的大概是别的东西。

lines.en: : This conversation went from sentimental and cute to mildly disturbing within a matter of seconds.
lines.zh: : 这段对话几秒之内,就从温情可爱变成了轻度惊悚。

lines.en: : Heheh~ You’re a growing boy, [amimaster]. Things like that are natural.
lines.zh: : 呵呵~ 你是个正在成长的男孩嘛,[amimaster]。那种事很自然的。

lines.en: : You never would have needed all of those tissues if you’d have just pounced on me earlier, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是早点扑上来,那些纸巾根本用不着。

lines.en: : That would have snapped me out of my slump, really quick. Like pressing a reset button.
lines.zh: : 那样我立马就能走出颓废期,快得像按了重置键。

lines.en: : Okay, well, on a slightly different note, I’m glad that things aren’t like that anymore.
lines.zh: : 好,换个稍微正经的话题——我很庆幸现在一切都不一样了。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’d be able to live if the house was that filthy.
lines.zh: : 要是这房子还那么脏,我怕是活不下去。

lines.en: : What we were doing back then could barely be called “living” anyway.
lines.zh: : 再说,我们那时候干的那些事,勉强才配得上叫「活着」。

lines.en: : We were kinda just drifting along from one day to the next, surviving off of garlic bread and soda.
lines.zh: : 我们就是一天混过一天,靠蒜香面包和汽水续命。

lines.en: : So I was spacious after all...
lines.zh: : 所以我果然还是「空旷」过啊……

lines.en: : Hahaha~ Maybe a teensy bit.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈~ 就一丢丢。

lines.en: : But now you’re big and strong and can protect me if I ever get attacked by a rottweiler.
lines.zh: : 但现在你高大又强壮,要是有罗威纳犬攻击我,你还能保护我。

lines.en: : You say some really strange things sometimes, you know?
lines.zh: : 你有时候说的话真的很怪,你知道吗?

lines.en: ///////////////////////////////////////////PLEASE MAKE SURE ALL WIRES ARE PROPERLY CONNECTED
///////////////////////////////////////////ATTEMPTING TO RESTORE CONNECTION
: I’m not the only one who says strange things, [amimaster].
lines.zh: : 会说怪话的又不只有我,[amimaster]。

lines.en: : Like, remember how you fell asleep in the classroom a few months ago and didn’t even know who I was when you woke up?
lines.zh: : 比如,几个月前你在教室里睡着,醒来连我是谁都不记得,还记得吧?

lines.en: : What was up with that?
lines.zh: : 那到底是怎么回事?

lines.en: : It’s like you were a different person all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 你就像突然换了个人。

lines.en: What Ami still doesn’t understand is that I was a different person all of a sudden.
lines.zh: Ami 仍不明白的是:我确实是突然换了个人。

lines.en: My life changed dramatically that day.
lines.zh: 那一天,我的人生发生了剧变。

lines.en: Just as hers did when her parents were turned into a roadside sculpture of steel and shattered bones.
lines.zh: 正如她的父母变成路边一座钢筋与碎骨的雕塑时,她的人生也发生过的一样。

lines.en: Life changes for everyone.
lines.zh: 人生对每个人都会变脸。

lines.en: Sometimes, you grow fat and pace around your room for months on end as a result.
lines.zh: 有时候,作为结果,你会发胖,并在自己的房间里徘徊数月。

lines.en: You leave food out on your desk.
lines.zh: 把吃剩的食物留在桌上。

lines.en: Flies find it and lay eggs.
lines.zh: 苍蝇找上门来,产下卵。

lines.en: The eggs hatch.
lines.zh: 卵孵化了。

lines.en: Then, before long, maggots consume everything as your traumatized [niece] finds new ways to please herself on the opposite end of the house.
lines.zh: 然后,用不了多久,蛆虫啃食一切——与此同时,你饱受创伤的 [niece],正在屋子的另一头,开发让自己好受的新方法。

lines.en: Anything to distract from the pain.
lines.zh: 只要能从痛苦里分神,什么都行。

lines.en: That is all life is and that is all we are.
lines.zh: 人生仅此而已,我们也仅此而已。

lines.en: : I’m feeling really tired now that I get to lay like this, [amimaster].
lines.zh: : 真的躺下来了,反倒觉得好累,[amimaster]。

lines.en: : Really? It doesn’t seem like a very comfortable position.
lines.zh: : 是吗?这个姿势看起来不太舒服啊。

lines.en: : Any position is fine as long as you’re with me.
lines.zh: : 只要跟你在一起,什么姿势都舒服。

lines.en: : I could probably sleep standing up as long as you’re in the same room.
lines.zh: : 只要在同一个房间,我大概站着都能睡着。

lines.en: : But, then again, I’m also kind of crazy for you, so that might just be a special thing only I would be able to do.
lines.zh: : 不过话又说回来,我也是真的为你着迷,所以说不定这是只有我才能做到的特技。

lines.en: : Do I make you comfortable as well, [amimaster]?
lines.zh: : 那我让你觉得安心吗,[amimaster]?

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的?

lines.en: : Then how come you won’t finger me?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不肯用手指宠幸我?

lines.en: : Is it because we’re family?
lines.zh: : 是因为我们是家人吗?

lines.en: : Does that make it a problem for you?
lines.zh: : 这对你来说是个问题吗?

lines.en: : I think it’s okay for family members to help each other out like that, [amimaster].
lines.zh: : 我觉得家人之间互相帮这种忙,完全没问题,[amimaster]。

lines.en: : In fact, I don’t think there’s anyone else in the world who I’d rather have fuck me from dawn ‘til dusk.
lines.zh: : 事实上,这世上要是论从清晨到日暮陪我做的对象,我谁都不想换。

lines.en: : ...Ami, I-
lines.zh: : ……Ami,我——

lines.en: : Ahhh~ I’m feeling really tired all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 啊啊~ 我突然好困。

lines.en: : It’s okay if I sleep here, right?
lines.zh: : 我睡在这里,可以吧?

lines.en: : Wake me up in a few hours if you want dessert or something.
lines.zh: : 想吃甜点之类的话,过几个小时叫我。

lines.en: : I picked up a cake on the way home today.
lines.zh: : 我今天回家路上买了个蛋糕。

lines.en: : Goodnight, [amimaster]~
lines.zh: : 晚安,[amimaster]~

lines.en: : I love you~
lines.zh: : 我爱你~

lines.en: : I love you too...
lines.zh: : 我也爱你……

lines.en: I’m not sure what that little outburst was about, but-
lines.zh: 我不太确定刚才那一小串爆发是怎么回事,但是——

lines.en: Well, actually-
lines.zh: 嗯,其实——

lines.en: Correction: I am sure of what that little outburst was about.
lines.zh: 更正:我非常清楚刚才那一小串爆发是怎么回事。

lines.en: But I’ve already decided that I won’t be pursuing a relationship like that with Ami.
lines.zh: 但我已经决定,不与 Ami 发展那种关系。

lines.en: And even if that’s what she wants, I can’t possibly bring myself to defile her that way.
lines.zh: 就算那是她想要的,我也没办法狠下心,用那种方式玷污她。

lines.en: So, it will probably be best for everyone if she continues to keep her feelings for me private.
lines.zh: 所以,对她来说最好的选择,大概是继续把对我的心意藏起来。

lines.en: There’s no way it would ever work out between us if others caught wind of anything more than how we’re supposed to be...
lines.zh: 要是让别人察觉到一丝超出「我们本该如此」的东西,我们之间就再也完了……

lines.en: Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!

lines.en: You can now invite her over to her own house every night if you’d like!
lines.zh: 现在,只要你愿意,每晚都可以邀请她来她自己的家!

lines.en: Normally, you’d also get the option to do all kinds of sexual stuff with her, but it appears you made a mistake somewhere, so that part won’t happen!
lines.zh: 正常情况下,你还会解锁与她进行各种性行为的选项,但看来你在某处出了错,所以这部分不会发生!

lines.en: Imagine having morals in a place like this.
lines.zh: 想象一下,在这种地方讲道德。

lines.en: : That makes me really happy.
lines.zh: : 这让我特别特别开心。

lines.en: : The fact that the two of us can be ourselves together now...
lines.zh: : 我们俩终于可以在彼此面前做回自己了……

lines.en: : It’s unlike anything I would have ever wished for.
lines.zh: : 这是我从前想都不敢想的事。

lines.en: : I’ll admit, even though it was super weird, my heart skipped a beat when you “invited me over” today.
lines.zh: : 我承认,虽然超级怪,但今天你「邀请我过来」的时候,我的心漏跳了一拍。

lines.en: : It was almost like being asked out on a date- just the date was to your room and all we did was talk.
lines.zh: : 简直像被约出去约会——只不过地点是你的房间,而我们做的事只有聊天。

lines.en: : But I got to lay on my favorite bed in the whole wide world with my favorite man in the whole wide world.
lines.zh: : 但我躺在了全世界我最喜欢的床上,和全世界我最喜欢的人。

lines.en: : And there’s nothing else that I’d have rather done.
lines.zh: : 没有比这更想做的事了。

lines.en: : Stay with me forever, [amimaster].
lines.zh: : 永远陪着我吧,[amimaster]。

lines.en: : Stay with me forever and I’ll make you happier than anyone has ever made anyone in the history of the universe.
lines.zh: : 永远陪着我,我会让你成为宇宙历史上,被任何人让任何人幸福过的人里,最幸福的那一个。

lines.en: Ami falls asleep several minutes later.
lines.zh: 几分钟后,Ami 睡着了。

lines.en: Her hand drops to the side and hangs just an inch or two off of the floor.
lines.zh: 她的手垂到床边,离地板只剩一两寸。

lines.en: I think more about how she said that floor used to be, covered in trash from neglect, and I wonder what it must have been like for her and the old Sensei during those dark, hopeless times.
lines.zh: 我想起她说的,这块地板曾经的模样——被疏于打理的垃圾覆盖——不禁好奇,在那段黑暗而绝望的日子里,她和原来的 Sensei 是怎么熬过来的。

lines.en: I imagine it must have been hard.
lines.zh: 我猜一定很难。

lines.en: And in imagining that-
lines.zh: 而在想象的同时——

lines.en: I wonder if it would ever be possible for me to feel that much all at once.
lines.zh: 我开始怀疑,自己是否有可能同时感受到那么多东西。

lines.en: Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!

lines.en: Welcome to the invite over tooltip!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到「邀请过夜」功能说明!

lines.en: In Lessons in Love, you have the option to invite characters over during nights to increase your level with them in either affection or lust.
lines.zh: 在《Lessons in Love》中,你可以在夜晚邀请角色过夜,以此提升你对她的 affection(好感)或 lust(欲望)等级。

lines.en: Before you’re able to choose, though, you must play through both of the respective character’s invite-over introductory events.
lines.zh: 不过在做出选择之前,你必须先完成该角色的两段「邀请过夜」前置事件。

lines.en: The first one will be meant to introduce them to your house-
lines.zh: 第一段用来把她介绍到你的家——

lines.en: And the second one will be reserved for performing sex acts with/on them!
lines.zh: 而第二段,则专门用来与她进行各种性行为!

lines.en: After that, you’ll be able to choose between affection or lust each time you invite them over, and gain a bonus of 3 points in whichever stat you decide on.
lines.zh: 之后,每次邀请她过夜,你都可以在 affection 和 lust 之间二选一,并获得所选属性 3 点的加成。

lines.en: You can even change the outfits they wear during the invite-over animations based on how high your affection or lust level is with them!
lines.zh: 你甚至可以根据好感或欲望等级的高低,更换她们在过夜动画里的服装!

lines.en: Invite over events will be colored light blue in the event tracker, so you’ll always know when a new one is available.
lines.zh: 「邀请过夜」事件在事件追踪器里显示为浅蓝色,所以你总能知道什么时候有新事件解锁。

lines.en: More are sure to pop up over time.
lines.zh: 随着时间推移,还会有更多解锁。

lines.en: Since I suppose that’s all you really need to know for now, I’ll let you get back to the game!
lines.zh: 我想你需要知道的就这些了,那么,回到游戏中去吧!

lines.en: Thanks as always for playing!
lines.zh: 一如既往,感谢游玩!
